verdict.rationale: Official docs say Logseq can export the entire graph as EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML. Community users confirm the data is local, and some back it up with GitHub, which supports leaving with your data. One user reports its Markdown adds spacing that breaks compatibility with tools like Obsidian, and another notes the new database version no longer keeps data as plain Markdown files. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that a full export imports cleanly into another tool, Markdown compatibility with other apps, and clarity on export fidelity in the new database version.
